  • Uses of MCS.Result in org.openscience.cdk.isomorphism

    Methods in org.openscience.cdk.isomorphism that return MCS.Result
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    MCS.Result
    MCS.search(IAtomContainer target)
    Find a maximum common substructure of the query and the target, and return the best mapping found even when the time limit ends the search first.
    MCS.Result
    MCS.searchAll(IAtomContainer target)
    Find every maximum common substructure mapping of the query and the target, up to 1000 of them as MCS.matchAll(IAtomContainer) does, and return those found even when the time limit ends the search first.
    MCS.Result
    MCS.searchAll(IAtomContainer target, int limit)
    Find maximum common substructure mappings of the query and the target, at most limit of them as MCS.matchAll(IAtomContainer, int) does, and return those found even when the time limit ends the search first.
